name: daintreehq.continue-session
description: Continue a Codex session in Claude Code, or a Claude Code session in Codex. The old session is indexed read-only on this machine, and the new agent starts in the same worktree with a short hand-off and one tool to search the old conversation.
tagline: Carry a Codex or Claude Code session over to the other CLI

commands.title: Continue in another agent
commands.description: Convert this pane's Codex or Claude Code session into a local searchable index and continue it in the other CLI, in the same worktree.

commands.title: Continue a converted session
commands.description: Start the continuing agent for a session that was already converted.

commands.title: Converted sessions
commands.description: List this project's converted sessions with their size, share them with every agent in the project, or delete them.

agentMcp.name: Converted sessions
agentMcp.description: Search a Codex or Claude Code session this agent continues.
